q: The Foreign Contribution (Regulation) Amendment Bill, 2026 has been referred to which body for detailed examination?
options: Parliamentary Standing Committee on Home Affairs
explanation: The FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 has been referred to a Joint Parliamentary Committee (JPC) for detailed examination and wider stakeholder consultations.

q: The FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026 proposes to establish a Designated Authority primarily for:
options: Supervising and disposing of foreign-funded assets after FCRA registration ceases
explanation: The Bill proposes a framework for managing assets created from foreign contributions after an organization's FCRA registration ends.

q: Which of the following is proposed under the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026?
explanation: The Bill proposes activity-based registration, stronger reporting requirements and rationalized penalties. It does not remove FCRA compliance requirements.

q: Which of the following is NOT mentioned as a concern regarding the FCRA Amendment Bill, 2026?
explanation: Concerns include institutional autonomy, natural justice, property rights, judicial oversight, federalism, civil society and excessive executive discretion.

q: New SIM card rules announced by the Department of Telecommunications became effective from:
explanation: From August 24, 2026, telecom service providers are required to strictly enforce the prescribed limit on the number of SIM cards an individual can hold.

q: India's merchandise exports grew by what percentage year-on-year in July 2026?
explanation: India's merchandise exports increased by 19.6% year-on-year, reaching approximately USD 44.2 billion.

q: India's merchandise exports in July 2026 reached approximately:
explanation: Merchandise exports reached USD 44.2 billion in July 2026.

q: India's merchandise imports grew by 17.5% in July 2026 to approximately:
explanation: Merchandise imports increased by 17.5% to approximately USD 76.2 billion.

q: India's services exports in July 2026 amounted to approximately:
explanation: Services exports grew by 6.4% to USD 35.9 billion.

q: Which sector accounted for approximately 39% of India's merchandise export growth in July 2026?
explanation: Petroleum products contributed approximately 39% of the total export growth, partly due to elevated global prices.

q: India's electronic goods exports grew by what percentage in July 2026?
explanation: Electronic goods exports recorded strong growth of 30.7%.

q: India's engineering goods exports grew by approximately:
explanation: Engineering goods exports increased by 18.2% during the period.

q: Which of the following is associated with the 'Middle-Technology Trap' faced by India?
options: Difficulty competing with low-cost economies while lagging in high-tech manufacturing
explanation: India faces challenges competing with low-cost economies in labour-intensive sectors while also remaining behind advanced economies in high-technology manufacturing.

q: India's Gross Domestic Expenditure on Research and Development (GERD) is approximately:
explanation: GERD of around 0.65% of GDP is identified as a constraint on India's innovation and technological competitiveness.

q: The EU's Carbon Border Adjustment Mechanism (CBAM) is an example of:
explanation: CBAM and stringent ESG compliance requirements can act as non-tariff barriers affecting India's export competitiveness.

q: The trilateral defence agreement involving Saudi Arabia, Türkiye and Pakistan is based on the principle of:
explanation: The agreement follows the principle that an armed attack against one signatory would be considered an attack against all.

q: The Saudi Arabia-Türkiye-Pakistan defence agreement was signed at:
explanation: The agreement was signed at Al-Safa Palace in Makkah, Saudi Arabia.

q: Which AI models were used to design functional bacteriophage genomes?
explanation: Researchers used the generative AI models Evo 1 and Evo 2 to design complete bacteriophage genomes.

q: Out of 285 AI-designed bacteriophage genomes synthesized and tested, how many successfully produced viable phages?
explanation: 16 of the 285 AI-designed genomes successfully produced viable phages capable of infecting E. coli.

q: The green AI data centre approved by Andhra Pradesh is proposed to have an integrated capacity of:
explanation: AM AI Factory Pvt Ltd is proposed to establish a 512 MW integrated AI data centre facility in Visakhapatnam.

q: The proposed green AI data centre in Andhra Pradesh is located at Amanam village in:
explanation: The proposed facility is at Amanam village in Bheemunipatnam mandal, Visakhapatnam region.

q: The proposed domestic polysilicon manufacturing capacity targeted by 2030 is:
explanation: MNRE is formulating a subsidy scheme to establish 30 GW of domestic polysilicon manufacturing capacity by 2030.

q: Polysilicon is particularly important for the production of:
explanation: Polysilicon is a high-purity crystalline form of silicon and is a key raw material for solar photovoltaic manufacturing.

q: The 2026 Asian Games, for which India has named a 12-member Kabaddi squad, will be held in:
explanation: The 2026 Asian Games are scheduled to be held in Aichi-Nagoya, Japan, from September 19 to October 4, 2026.

q: Who among the following is a member of India's 2026 Asian Games Kabaddi squad mentioned in the current affairs?
explanation: Experienced Kabaddi player Pawan Sehrawat is included alongside younger Pro Kabaddi League players such as Ayan Lohchab and Devank Dalal.

q: Who became the leading wicket-taker in ICC World Test Championship history according to the given current affairs?
explanation: Australia's left-arm fast bowler Mitchell Starc surpassed Pat Cummins and Nathan Lyon to become the leading wicket-taker in WTC history.

q: Mansi Lather won which medal in the 68 kg category at the U20 World Championships?
explanation: Mansi Lather won the silver medal in the 68 kg category. Tanvi Gundesh Magdum and Komal won bronze medals.

q: Grandmaster Pranesh M won the Kanizsa Open 2026 in:
explanation: Indian Grandmaster Pranesh M won the Group A title at the Kanizsa Open 2026 in Nagykanizsa, Hungary, after winning on superior tie-break scores.

q: Australia's first confirmed mainland mammal case of H5N1 avian influenza was detected in a:
explanation: H5N1 was detected in a dead long-nosed fur seal at Beachport, South Australia.

q: Regenerative agriculture primarily emphasizes:
explanation: Regenerative agriculture focuses on improving soil health, biodiversity and ecological resilience, especially in the face of water stress and climate variability.

q: INS Mangrol is associated with which type of vessel?
explanation: Mangrol is the third indigenously built Anti-Submarine Warfare Shallow Water Craft (ASW-SWC) delivered to the Indian Navy.

q: The third indigenous ASW-SWC, Mangrol, was constructed by:
explanation: Cochin Shipyard Limited (CSL) constructed Mangrol for the Indian Navy.

q: Exercise Udara Shakti 2026 was conducted in:
explanation: The Indian Air Force participated in the bilateral tactical air combat exercise Udara Shakti 2026 in Malaysia.

q: Before participating in Udara Shakti 2026, the Indian Air Force participated in which exercise in Australia?
explanation: The IAF participated in Exercise Pitch Black 2026 in Australia before concluding its involvement in Udara Shakti 2026 in Malaysia.

q: The first fully indigenous AK-203 assault rifle is named:
explanation: The first fully indigenously developed AK-203 assault rifle has been named Sher.

q: The indigenous AK-203 'Sher' rifle was manufactured and tested at Korwa in:
explanation: The rifle was manufactured and tested by Indo-Russian Rifles Private Limited (IRRPL) at its Korwa factory in Amethi, Uttar Pradesh.

q: The nationwide Cloud and AI skilling initiative is primarily focused on:
explanation: NSDC and Cultus Education, with AWS support, launched a 100% online workforce development programme focused on Cloud and AI skills.

q: Which organization supported the nationwide Cloud and AI skilling initiative?
explanation: Amazon Web Services (AWS) is supporting the initiative along with NSDC and Cultus Education.

q: What is the total outlay approved for the Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana?
explanation: The Union Cabinet approved the PM-SSY with a total outlay of ₹5,070 crore.

q: The Pradhan Mantri Surya Sarovar Yojana aims to deploy floating solar photovoltaic projects with a capacity of:
explanation: PM-SSY aims to deploy 5,000 MW of Floating Solar Photovoltaic (FSPV) projects across reservoirs and inland water bodies.

q: Under PM-SSY, the proposed battery energy storage capacity is:
explanation: The scheme integrates 10,000 MWh of battery energy storage systems with floating solar projects.

q: Consider the following pairs: 1. Mitchell Starc - Cricket, 2. Pranesh M - Chess, 3. Mansi Lather - Wrestling, 4. Pawan Sehrawat - Kabaddi. Which of the above pairs are correctly matched?
explanation: All four pairs are correctly matched with their respective sports.

q: Which of the following correctly describes PM-SSY?
options: It focuses exclusively on rooftop solar panels.
It promotes floating solar projects on reservoirs and inland water bodies.
It is a scheme for offshore wind farms.
It provides subsidies only for electric vehicles.
explanation: PM-SSY promotes Floating Solar Photovoltaic (FSPV) projects, helping address land constraints while supporting water conservation.

q: Which of the following is a proposed strategy to improve India's export competitiveness?
options: Promote high-tech Global Value Chain integration
explanation: Recommendations include deeper integration into high-tech Global Value Chains, particularly in sectors such as semiconductors and green energy.

q: Which one of the following correctly matches the initiative with its objective?
options: PM-SSY - Floating solar and energy storage
explanation: PM-SSY focuses on floating solar photovoltaic projects integrated with battery energy storage, while the other pairings are incorrect.
